prompt: Out of all of Steven Spielberg's Oscar winning movies up until 2020, which one has made the most money?
answer: **Jurassic Park (1993)** has made the most money among Steven Spielberg-directed films that won Oscars. It won **three Academy Awards** and earned **over $1 billion worldwide**—more than any other Oscar-winning Spielberg film as of 2020.
